title: Viva Insights: leaders can publish Power BI reports
summary: The briefing passes: the planned leader publishing behaviour and rollout match Microsoft's notice, and the policy commands remain documented. Minor corrections should complete the policy paths, distinguish existing platform licensing from the unpublished leader-specific requirement, and qualify email notifications for existing analyst publishing.
